caption: The drawing depicts two views of a vehicle resembling a carriage or rickshaw and a decorative textile pattern. On the upper half, the left side shows a side profile of the carriage, which consists of two large tan wheels with black centers, a black body with a curved seat, tan structural elements, a high and curved handle, and a rectangular canopy with blue fringe. To the right of this, a front view of the same carriage is provided, revealing a tufted, orange seat, additional tan framework, a black footrest, upright posts, and a matching rectangular blue-fringed canopy supported by slender rods. Below these views, a rectangular swatch of patterned fabric is depicted; it has a repeating design of cream, black, and pink-red shapes, including crosses and clover motifs, set against a dark reddish background. The artist's signature, "R. Miller," appears in the bottom right corner of the patterned rectangle. The entire composition is set against a plain off-white background.
title: Doll Buggy and Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
